source.source_dataset: UK Department for Transport Journey Time Statistics
source.source_title: Primary school access and journey time indicators by local authority, England, 2014
source.license: Open Government Licence v3.0 (GOV.UK default, except where otherwise stated)
modifications: Keep the 31 source fields and 361 records, with original numeric and textual values
Reconstruct a 3-level semantic transport-mode / metric-type / time-threshold header with actual cell merges
Merge consecutive identical Region labels only; preserve source local-authority records
Add a 32nd column of signed mean-minimum-travel-time gap as PSPTt (PS101) minus PSCart (PS119)
Store each gap as a same-row Excel formula with a cached numerical result
Retain source indicator IDs and codes in Excel header comments

operation_nodes.target: Three-level semantic headers and contiguous Region row grouping
Average minimum journey time: public transport/walking minus car

rules.column_order: 31 original fields in source order; append derived gap
rules.header_semantics: each travel mode has 1 average minimum journey time, 4 origin accessibility counts, 4 destination percentage indicators
rules.formula: PSPTt - PSCart, minutes, same local authority
rules.percentage: source stored as percentage points (94 means 94%), never convert to .94
rules.source_traceability: field codes and indicator IDs preserved in header comments
rules.original_data_fidelity: exact source values, types and text, except repeated region labels represented by merged regions
rules.layout_equivalence: header can be preceded by arbitrary short title rows, must retain 3 header levels

evaluation.scaffold: lightweight tool-calling agent; evaluator runs outside sandbox

composition_notes: OP7 and OP2 both appear in the output; OP2 depends on mapping two source fields but need not depend on the header rebuild itself.
